history_after.correction: returned_to_nuxel was recorded as false because the Python console client could not verify ANY frame at that time: the target tty ends its lines with CRLF and the frame parser matched bare LF, so every command was reported framed=false/sha_ok=false even though the device answered correctly.  That defect is fixed (CRLF normalisation in tools/beta/live/nuxel_live.py, this session).  The handset DID return to Nuxel: the non-charger baseline docs/beta-finalization/live/evidence/baseline-20261016T222451+0200 shows 41/41 frames verified with androidboot.mode absent, sec_touchscreen registered and nuxel-wayland/nuxel-wl-fb/nuxel-button-manager/nuxel-touch-arm/seatd all active.
history_after.diagnostic: re-read /proc/cmdline for androidboot.mode and confirm sec_touchscreen is registered
